candidates.change_summary: Replace the balance accumulation `balances[msg.sender] += msg.value` with an assignment `balances[msg.sender] = msg.value`, discarding any prior balance.
Replace `msg.value` with `1` so each deposit always credits exactly 1 wei regardless of the value sent.
Delete the balance decrement so withdrawn funds remain credited to the caller's balance.
Replace the correct decrement with a fixed decrement of 1, leaving the remaining balance incorrect for amounts other than 1.
Insert a statement that also credits the withdrawn amount to the creator's balance after the decrement.
Replace the decrement with a zeroing assignment so any withdrawal wipes the entire balance.
Change the transfer amount from the full contract balance to 1 wei, so migrateTo sends a different value.
Delete the transfer statement so migrateTo no longer sends any funds out of the contract.
Send the contract balance to the creator instead of the given recipient address, changing who receives the funds and the value delivered to `to`.
Remove the creator-only guard so any caller can trigger the migration transfer.
Transfer the caller's recorded balance instead of the entire contract balance, changing the amount sent by migrateTo.
